# Synergistic_Route

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mechanism by which multiple weak interactions or perturbations collectively drive a system toward a critical point, rather than a single dominant control parameter. Enables robust and distributed tuning of in-network neuromorphic hardware without requiring precise global parameter control.
